decision_description: For the Phase 4 timeline and milestone schedule, the project duration bound was set to 30 months (M1-M30) using project_duration_months = 30 from selected_call.json, rather than the call-level maximum of 36 months stated in that same file's project_duration_note. All 31 tasks and all six milestones (MS1 due M6 through MS6 due M30) were placed within the 30-month window, with WP5 extended to M30 to cover the M25-M30 AgroVIR non-academic placement. The independent milestone-consistency-check (report milestone_consistency_gantt_designer_2026-08-13T12:45:30Z) confirmed all six milestones consistent and within duration (6/6 passed, 0 flagged).
alternatives_considered: Bound the timeline to the call-level maximum of 36 months from selected_call.json project_duration_note (Global Fellowships incl. 12-month return). Rejected: the operator-confirmed project fact is a 30-month action (24-month European Fellowship at ELTE plus a 6-month non-academic placement at AgroVIR under CC-07); scheduling to 36 months would exceed the confirmed action envelope and mis-state the fellowship type.

Terminate WP5 at M24 with the placement modelled outside the project timeline. Rejected: the M25-M30 placement is a confirmed part of the action duration and its deliverables (D5.4, D5.5) and MS6 depend on it, so it must fall inside the scheduled window.
tier_authority_applied: Tier 3 selected_call.json (project_duration_months = 30, status Confirmed; project_duration_status Confirmed) and CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 4 gate condition ("Timeline fits within the call-specified duration")
rationale: CLAUDE.md §5 makes Tier 3 the sole authoritative source for project-specific facts, and §12.2 requires design decisions to rest on Confirmed evidence. project_duration_months = 30 is an operator-confirmed (2026-08-11) Confirmed project fact and is the field phase_04_gate's timeline_within_duration predicate reads by name; the 36-month figure is call-level context, not the confirmed project envelope. Binding the timeline to the Confirmed 30-month duration keeps the Gantt reproducible from documented Tier 3 inputs and satisfies the Phase 4 gate condition that the timeline fit within the applicable duration.
